camel_example: aliyun adb DescribeDBClusters --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key tag1 --DBVersion '3.0' --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-4690g37929XXXX' --DBClusterIds 'am-bp1r053byu48p0000' --PageNumber 1 --DBClusterStatus Running --DBClusterVersion '3.0' --Tag.1.Value test1 --DBClusterDescription test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-clusters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-ids am-bp1r053byu48p0000 --db-cluster-description test --db-cluster-status Running --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --resource-group-id rg-4690g37929XXXX --tag Value=test1 Key=tag1 --db-version 3.0 --db-cluster-version 3.0 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusters

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to view available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看可用地域的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can specify any cluster ID in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以输入上述地域中任意的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The cluster description.

It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
集群描述。
不能以`http://`或者`https://`开头。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The cluster status. Valid values:

Preparing: Preparing.

Creating: Creating.

Restoring: Restoring from a backup.

Running: Running.

Deleting: Deleting.

ClassChanging: Upgrading or downgrading specifications.

NetAddressCreating: Creating a network endpoint.

NetAddressDeleting: Deleting a network endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
集群状态，取值说明：
Preparing：准备中
Creating：创建中
Restoring：备份恢复中
Running：运行中
Deleting：删除中
ClassChanging：变配中
NetAddressCreating：创建网络中
NetAddressDeleting：删除网络中
parameters.name: db_cluster_status

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30 (default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values are integers greater than 0 and less than or equal to the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can filter clusters by tag keys. You can specify up to 20 key-value pairs. The numbers n in `Tag.N.Key` and `Tag.N.Value` must be unique and consecutive integers starting from 1.

A tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。`Tag.N.Key`对应的值为`Tag.N.Value`。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或者`https://`开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. You can filter clusters by tag values. You can specify up to 20 key-value pairs. The numbers n in `Tag.N.Key` and `Tag.N.Value` must be unique and consecutive integers starting from 1.

A tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签值，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。`Tag.N.Key`对应的值为`Tag.N.Value`。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或者`https://`开头
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
Cluster version

3.0: Data Warehouse Edition.

5.0 (default): Includes the Data Lakehouse Edition, Enterprise Edition, and Basic Edition.

All: All versions, including the Data Warehouse Edition, Data Lakehouse Edition, Enterprise Edition, and Basic Edition
parameters.help_zh:
集群版本
3.0：数仓版。
5.0（默认值）：包括湖仓版、企业版和基础版。
All：所有版本，包括数仓版、湖仓版、企业版和基础版
parameters.name: db_cluster_version

Category.description_en:
The product edition. Valid values:

BASIC: Basic Edition in reserved mode.

CLUSTER: Cluster Edition in reserved mode.

MIXED_STORAGE: Cluster Edition in flexible mode (new).

For more information, see [Product editions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）
Category.description_zh:
产品系列，取值说明：
BASIC：预留模式基础版
CLUSTER：预留模式集群版
MIXED_STORAGE：弹性模式集群版（新版）

更多关于集群系列的介绍，请参见[产品系列]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）

CommodityCode.description_en: The commodity code. Fixed value: ads

ComputeResource.description_en: The compute resource specification used in flexible mode for data processing. Increasing compute resources speeds up queries. You can scale these resources up or down as needed
ComputeResource.description_zh: 弹性模式下使用的计算资源规格，用于数据计算。增加计算资源能加快查询速度，可以根据集群实际性能按需弹性扩缩

ConnectionString.description_en: The public endpoint of the cluster

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created, in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. Example: 2021-04-01T09:50:18Z
CreateTime.description_zh: 集群创建时间，UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，例如2021-04-01T09:50:18Z

DBClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type of the cluster. Only VPC is supported
DBClusterNetworkType.description_zh: 集群网络类型。仅支持VPC（专有网络）类型

DBClusterStatus.description_en: The cluster status. For more information, see [State table]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143075.html）
DBClusterStatus.description_zh: 集群状态。更多详情，请参见[集群状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143075.html）

DBClusterType.description_en:
The cluster type. Valid values:

Common: Standard cluster.

RDS_ANALYSIS: MySQL analytic instance. <props="china">For more information, see [Overview of MySQL analytic instances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）.</props>
DBClusterType.description_zh:
集群类型，取值说明：
Common：常规集群。
RDS_ANALYSIS：MySQL分析实例。<props="china"><ph>更多详情，请参见[MySQL分析实例简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）。</ph></props>

DBNodeStorage.description_en: The storage capacity of the cluster, in GB

DBVersion.description_en: The database version. Only version 3.0 is supported
DBVersion.description_zh: 数据库版本，当前仅支持3.0版本

DiskType.description_en:
The disk type. Valid values:

local_ssd: Local SSD.

cloud: Basic disk.

cloud_ssd: Standard SSD.

cloud_efficiency: Ultra disk.

cloud_essd0: ESSD PL0.

cloud_essd: ESSD PL1.

cloud_essd2: ESSD PL2.

cloud_essd3: ESSD PL3.

For more information about ESSDs, see [ESSD specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html）
DiskType.description_zh:
集群的磁盘类型，取值说明：
local_ssd：本地磁盘。
cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_essd0：PL0等级的ESSD云盘。
cloud_essd：PL1等级的ESSD云盘。
cloud_essd2：PL2 等级的ESSD云盘。
cloud_essd3：PL3 等级的ESSD云盘。

更多关于ESSD云盘的详情，请参见[ESSD云盘规格]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html）

DtsJobId.description_en: The DTS sync task ID. This parameter is returned only for MySQL analytic instances. <props="china">For more information, see [Overview of MySQL analytic instances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）.</props>
DtsJobId.description_zh: DTS同步任务ID。仅MySQL分析实例会返回该参数。<props="china"><ph>更多详情，请参见[MySQL分析实例简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）。</ph></props>

ElasticIOResource.description_en:
The Elastic IO Unit (EIU). For more information, see [EIU overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189505.html）.

This parameter is returned only for clusters in flexible mode
ElasticIOResource.description_zh:
弹性IO资源（Elastic IO Unit，简称EIU），更多详情，请参见[EIU详解]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189505.html）。
仅弹性模式集群会返回该参数

Engine.description_en: The cluster engine. Fixed value: AnalyticDB

ExecutorCount.description_en: The number of compute nodes used by the cluster in flexible mode
ExecutorCount.description_zh: 弹性模式下集群使用的计算节点数量

ExpireTime.description_en:
The time when the cluster expires, in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. Example: 2999-09-08T16:00:00Z.

If the cluster uses the subscription billing method, this parameter returns the actual expiration time.

If the cluster uses the pay-as-you-go billing method, this parameter returns the fixed value 2999-09-08T16:00:00Z
ExpireTime.description_zh: 集群到期时间，UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，例如2999-09-08T16:00:00Z。 若目标集群付费模式为包年包月，则返回实际到期时间。 若目标集群付费模式为按量付费，则返回固定值2999-09-08T16:00:00Z

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true: Expired.

false: Not expired
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否过期。取值说明：
true：已过期。
false：未过期

LockMode.description_en:
The cluster lock mode. Valid values:

Unlock: Unlocked.

ManualLock: Manually locked.

LockByExpiration: Locked due to expiration.

LockByRestoration: Locked before rollback.

LockByDiskQuota: Locked because storage usage reached 90% of the quota
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定模式，取值说明：
Unlock：正常（即未锁定）。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定。
LockByRestoration：集群回滚前自动锁定。
LockByDiskQuota：集群中空间满（即数据占用的存储空间已到达上限水位的90%）自动锁定

LockReason.description_en:
The reason why the cluster is locked.

This parameter is returned only if the cluster is locked. Fixed value: instance_expire
LockReason.description_zh:
集群锁定原因。
仅当集群被锁定时会返回该参数，固定为instance_expire

Mode.description_en:
The cluster mode. Valid values:

flexible: Flexible mode.

reserver: Reserved mode.

For more information, see [Product editions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）
Mode.description_zh:
集群模式，取值说明：
flexible：弹性模式。
reserver：预留模式。

更多关于集群模式的介绍，请参见[产品系列]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Postpaid: Pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: Subscription
PayType.description_zh:
集群付费类型，取值说明：
Postpaid：按量付费（即后付费）。
Prepaid：包年包月（即预付费）

ProductVersion.description_en:
The product version. Valid values:

BasicVersion: Basic Edition.

EnterpriseVersion: Enterprise Edition
ProductVersion.description_zh:
产品版本。取值为：
BasicVersion：基础版。
EnterpriseVersion：企业版

RdsInstanceId.description_en: The source ApsaraDB RDS instance ID. This parameter is returned only for MySQL analytic instances. <props="china">For more information, see [Overview of MySQL analytic instances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）.</props>
RdsInstanceId.description_zh: 同步源RDS实例ID。仅MySQL分析实例会返回该参数。<props="china"><ph>更多详情，请参见[MySQL分析实例简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）。</ph></props>

RegionId.description_en: The region ID where the cluster resides

StorageResource.description_en: The storage resource specification used in flexible mode for read and write operations. Increasing this resource improves cluster read and write performance
StorageResource.description_zh: 弹性模式用的存储资源规格，用于数据读写，增加该资源能提高集群读写能力

Key.description_en:
The tag key.

You can call the [TagResources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179253.html） operation to add tags to a cluster
Key.description_zh:
标签键。
您可以调用[TagResources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179253.html）接口为目标集群创建标签

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: Waiting to run.

RUNNING: Running.

SUCCEED: Completed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态，取值为：
NOT_RUN：等待运行。
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCEED：已结束

EndTime.description_en: The time when the step ended. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
EndTime.description_zh: 步骤结束时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StartTime.description_en: The time when the step started. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
StartTime.description_zh: 步骤开始时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StepStatus.description_en:
The step status. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: Waiting to run.

RUNNING: Running.

SUCCEED: Completed
StepStatus.description_zh:
步骤状态，取值为：
NOT_RUN：等待运行。
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCEED：已结束

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID where the cluster resides

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
